Historical full-card image of [[At Last We Are Getting Results (V) (Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates) (Remastered 2006)|At Last We Are Getting Results]], matching the [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
